title: Unramified intermediate DVR from the standard tame unit-root calculation
statement: Let $B,U,T$ be DVR domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], let $\pi\in B$ be irreducible, and let $e\in\mathbf N$ be a unit in $B$. Suppose $B\to U$ is local and $k(U)/k(B)$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Let $E/\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ be finite separable [def-pc-field-extension], with compatible $B,U$ structures making $E=\operatorname{Frac}(U)$. Let $F=\operatorname{Frac}(T)$, $i_E:E\to F$ a field map, and $j:U\to T$ a local map whose composite to $F$ agrees with $i_E$ on $U$. Choose an irreducible $q\in U$ and a unit $w\in U$ with $q^e w=\pi$ in $U$. Put $R=B[t]/(t^e-\pi)$ and give it its domain and DVR structures. Suppose $\rho:R\to T$ is local, agrees on $B$ with $j$, and there is a unit $y\in T$ with $j(q)y=\rho(t)$. Then there exists a DVR domain $V$ with a local injective $R$-algebra structure, essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] and formally unramified (relative Kahler differentials zero); there is a local $k:V\to T$ extending $\rho$, a field map $i_V:\operatorname{Frac}(V)\to F$ extending $V\to T\to F$, and $i_{EV}:E\to\operatorname{Frac}(V)$ with $i_V\circ i_{EV}=i_E$. This constructs the intermediate standard-root model and does not assert any later base-change property.

proof.text: Injectivity of j follows from its compatibility with the field embeddings. Raise j(q)y=rho(t) to the e-th power and cancel j(q)^e to get y^e=j(w). Form D=U[Y]/(Y^e-w) with Y mapping to y in T. The proved source theorem AdjoinRoot.etale_X_pow_sub_C makes D etale over U.

Localize D at the inverse image of m(T), obtaining V and a local k:V->T. Flatness and formal unramifiedness give m(U)V=m(V); the closed source regularity ascent theorem makes V regular local and a domain. The image of q is nonzero by flatness and generates m(V), so V is a DVR. The root z of D in V is a unit.

Map R into V by t->qz, checking the root equation. Check k composed with this map equals rho on constants and the root. Thus R->V is local; its root maps to a nonzero uniformizer, so uniformizer factorization proves injectivity. The standard root algebra theorem supplies m(R)=(t).

Use the finite-separable-fraction essential-finite-type theorem on U/B; composition and restriction of scalars give essential finite type for V/R. Etaleness gives k(V)/k(U) separable. Transitivity gives separability over k(B), and restriction of the base along k(B)->k(R) gives separability over k(R). Since t maps to q times a unit, m(R)V=m(V). The Mathlib local unramified criterion proves formal unramifiedness of V/R.

The map k does not kill the uniformizer q, hence is injective by factorization. Extend V->T->F and U->V to fraction fields. Their composites agree on U and therefore on E=Frac(U), giving the required iV and iEV and every compatibility equality.

theorem dvr_standard_root_unramified_model
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    (U : Type u) [CommRing U] [IsDomain U] [IsDiscreteValuationRing U]
    [Algebra B U] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B U)]
    (e : ℕ) (he : IsUnit (e : B))
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField U))
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    [Algebra B E] [IsScalarTower B (FractionRing B) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E] [Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E]
    [Algebra U E] [IsFractionRing U E] [IsScalarTower B U E]
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [IsDiscreteValuationRing T]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra T F] [IsFractionRing T F]
    (iE : E →+* F) (j : U →+* T) (hj : IsLocalHom j)
    (hjE : ∀ c : U, algebraMap T F (j c) = iE (algebraMap U E c))
    (q : U) (hq : Irreducible q) (w : Uˣ)
    (hw : q ^ e * (w : U) = algebraMap B U pi) :
    let R := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ e - Polynomial.C pi)
    ∀ (hdom : IsDomain R) (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing R),
    letI := hdom
    letI := hdvr
    ∀ (rho : R →+* T) (_hrho : IsLocalHom rho)
      (_hrhoB : ∀ b : B, rho (algebraMap B R b) = j (algebraMap B U b))
      (y : Tˣ)
      (_hy : j q * (y : T) = rho (AdjoinRoot.root
        ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ e - Polynomial.C pi))),
    ∃ (V : Type u) (_ : CommRing V) (_ : IsDomain V)
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing V) (aRV : Algebra R V),
    letI := aRV
    ∃ (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R V)) (_ : FaithfulSMul R V)
      (_ : Algebra.EssFiniteType R V) (_ : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R V)
      (k : V →+* T) (_ : IsLocalHom k),
      (∀ r : R, k (algebraMap R V r) = rho r) ∧
      ∃ (iV : FractionRing V →+* F) (iEV : E →+* FractionRing V),
        (∀ v : V, iV (algebraMap V (FractionRing V) v) = algebraMap T F (k v)) ∧
        (∀ x : E, iV (iEV x) = iE x)
